correctness.rationale: The independent reconstruction from h(0)=01, h(1)=21, h(2)=0 gave the stated 37-letter sixth iterate, 17 length-eight factors, and 119 substitution-image windows with no closure failure. Non-erasing images ensure an eight-letter output window intersects at most eight consecutive input images; extending this input block to eight letters proves inductive exhaustiveness for the entire fixed point. Reversal disjointness at length eight excludes every longer reflected factor. Taking short subwords of the certified set (every shorter factor extends to the right) reproduces Q1–Q7, including 1012101 at length seven. Subtracting one class per nonpalindromic pair gives the stated small values; the empty word gives the length-zero value and Currie et al., Theorem 1, gives the 2n+1 tail. The finite check was reconstructed independently; the frozen script was inspected, not executed.
